evidence_quotes: Bij besluit van 18 april 2017 heeft de minister op grond van artikel 5.4 van de Waterwet het projectplan "Kadeverlaging Scherpekamp" vastgesteld.
rationale: The decision of the Dutch Raad van State concerns an administrative project plan ("Kadeverlaging Scherpekamp" — embankment lowering) adopted by the Minister as water manager pursuant to Article 5.4 of the Dutch Waterwet for modifying water management/flood-defence infrastructure (waterstaatswerk). It clearly falls within substantive water law and public water-authority infrastructure project-plan governance, with no household connection refusal or informal settlement issue.
